outcome: Adding the bot to a group is no longer dead air, and groups can finally bootstrap their first approver. When someone the bot already knows from a 1:1 chat adds it to a Telegram group or Slack channel, the group registers itself, that person becomes its first approver, and the bot says so in the room. Anyone the bot does not recognise gets a clear in-group message naming how to set an approver - and nothing else (fail-closed). Discord posts the same guidance once per new server; Teams stays documented-manual. The old Telegram DM Yes/No flow - which could never mint a first approver and never spoke in the group - is deleted. Approvals themselves are unchanged: the allowlist still governs groups.
